about: Third-party audio used to test Mesh's audio (M21A). The files are NOT in the repository: they are kept outside it, by default in D:/Games/Mesh-audio-assets/downloads (set MESH_AUDIO_ASSETS to use another folder), and tooling/audio_smoke.py checks each one's SHA-256 before using it. All CC0 (public domain); the authors are credited here although CC0 doesn't require it.

assets.use: music: a long looping track (MP3, 97 s, stereo 44.1 kHz)
assets.author: cynicmusic (cynicmusic.com, pixelsphere.org)
assets.notes: The author asks (not as a licence term) to be told when the music is used.

assets.use: ambience: a seamless environmental loop (MP3, 45 s, stereo 48 kHz)
assets.author: TinyWorlds (https://opengameart.org/users/tinyworlds)
assets.notes: Made for Ludum Dare 29 (The Woods); the page says it loops seamlessly.

not_downloaded.why: kenney.nl answered 403 to an automated download of its signed link (it expects its own page's browser session); not worked around, as instructed. Download it from the page in a browser if wanted.
As above: 403 to an automated download.
